Where to go in South Korea

All 12 destinations →

서울 · Seoul

Seoul

Joseon royal palaces, hanok lanes, 24-hour night markets, K-culture and mountain fortress trails.

부산 · Busan

Busan

Coastal boardwalks, Haeundae & Gwangalli beaches, cliffside temples and Jagalchi seafood market.

제주도 · Jeju Province

Jeju Island

Volcanic craters, Hallasan mountain trails, waterfalls, haenyeo divers and coastal cafés.

경주 · North Gyeongsang

Gyeongju

The 'museum without walls': ancient Silla royal burial mounds, Bulguksa Temple and Hwangnidan-gil.

전주 · North Jeolla

Jeonju

Over 700 traditional hanok houses, the birthplace of bibimbap, and lively makgeolli alleys.

인천 · Incheon

Incheon & Songdo

Futuristic Songdo Central Park, historic Chinatown, Wolmido boardwalk and West Sea islands.

속초·설악산 · Gangwon Province

Sokcho & Seoraksan

Granite peaks of Seoraksan National Park, East Sea beaches and Sokcho fish market.

강릉 · Gangwon Province

Gangneung

East coast pine beaches, Ojukheon heritage house, Chodang tofu village and Anmok coffee street.

How we write our guides

Practical first

We focus on the questions visitors actually face: which ticket to buy, how to get from the airport, what to do when a restaurant has a ticket machine.

Sources you can check

Entry rules, rail passes and prices change. Each guide links to the official source (JNTO, South Korea Railways, immigration and local tourism boards).

No invented reviews

We don't publish fake testimonials or made-up statistics. Prices are rough ranges meant to help you plan, not quotes.
